title: GraveGain 3d B: Dungeon Gunner
description: A fast dark-fantasy looter-shooter with a 10-mission campaign, hundreds of procedural gun builds, vertical dungeons, boss fights, a starship hub, and a customizable flying companion.

maker.name: Antigravity Dev
maker.bio: Specializing in high-fidelity HTML5 game experiences with immersive systems and rich game-feel.

keyboard.Mouse: Look (right-drag if pointer lock is unavailable)
keyboard.Y: Fire the M4 underbarrel grenade launcher; R reloads launcher ammo too
keyboard.G: Throw grenade (3 to start; loot replenishes, cap 5)
keyboard.N / Middle Mouse: Weapon bash (short-range strike with the equipped weapon)
keyboard.H: Drop current weapon (keep at least one)
keyboard.E: Pet your nearby companion to repair it and lift its mood
keyboard.U: Swap the equipped gun for a nearby drop when all four slots are full
keyboard.J: Save or remove the equipped procedural gun in the deployment armory
keyboard.M: Dodge in your movement direction, or forward from a standstill
keyboard.5–7: Choose one gun from the nearby starting field cache
keyboard.Shift: Hold while moving forward to build sprint speed. Press with sideways or backward movement to dodge.
keyboard.C: Slide while sprinting; crouch when held without sprint. Jump within 0.32 seconds of starting a slide to carry extra speed into a slide-hop.
keyboard.Space: Jump; tap again near a ledge to mantle, or press S + Space on a raised deck to drop through. In turn-based mode, wait a turn. Humans can hold to glide; Dwarves can double-jump.

instructions: Choose your race and class, equip a cat or dog battle drone, then fight through procedural first-person dungeon floors. The drone follows, attacks at range, and can revive you once; press E nearby to pet and repair it. Start with the M4, service pistol, and shotgun, then chase hundreds of procedural gun builds from caches and enemies. Sprint, Shift-dodge, slide-hop, mantle, jump between tiers, or drop through raised decks to control each fight. Enemies telegraph attacks, and bosses enrage below half health. Collect Gold, earn combat boons, and challenge the campaign bosses. Return to the LuckyStarShip hub to grow offline crops, exchange gold, and repair modules.
